title: Bahay's strong outing not enough to keep Ateneo's Final 4 bid alive

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Cebuano guard Jared Bahay scored 17 points, but the Ateneo de Manila University Blue Eagles absorbed an 89-84 defeat to the University of Santo Tomas (UST) Growling Tigers on Sunday, November 15, at the SMART Araneta Coliseum. Bahay also dished out eight assists, grabbed three rebounds, and recorded three steals in what turned out to be his final game in the University Athletic Association of the Philippines (UAAP) Season 89. His 17-point output was his second-highest scoring performance in the tournament, next only to the 18 points he scored against Adamson University on September 25. He also scored 16 […]...
